questions: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can each person pay a different amount, and can someone pay less than the full amount or pay twice in the same round?
Who decides which member collects in a round: do you pick them each time, or is there a fixed order that the system should follow?
Will you run more than one susu group, and can the same person be in more than one group, or is it only your one group at the market?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
